Then next timestamp. Keep order.

Also include any dialogue? None. So no <d> tags.

non_diegetic_music: minimal scene-appropriate underscore: maybe "low tense piano". Use something like "tension strings" but minimal. Provide a phrase.

At 00:04.200 Will steps up from the basement doorway onto the kitchen floor. At 00:04.400 Amber steps up from the basement doorway onto the kitchen floor.
